# Sportfolio

> Sportfolio is a fantasy sports market platform with AMM-based player pools, scout-share distribution, daily boosts, and public leaderboards.

- Canonical site: https://www.sportfolio.market
- Sitemap: https://www.sportfolio.market/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://www.sportfolio.market/robots.txt

- Do not index or summarize private user data.
- Do not use admin or authenticated endpoints.
